commands: set -e; EXPECTED=cf1ba40f30df2b6ee9ddd72d58a2bafe60852153; ACTUAL=$(git rev-parse HEAD); REMOTE=$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/work/phase1-live-call-probes | awk '{print $1}'); echo expected=$EXPECTED actual=$ACTUAL remote=$REMOTE; test "$ACTUAL" = "$EXPECTED"; test "$REMOTE" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

set -e; export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"; GRADLE="$HOME/.gradle/local-agent/gradle-9.6.0/bin/gradle"; "$GRADLE" :privileged-helper:testDebugUnitTest :privileged-helper:assembleDebug :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:assembleDebug; PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m unittest scripts/test_s22_call_control.py scripts/test_autonomous_call_loop.py; git diff --check; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo phase2_downlink_pfd_build_ok=true

set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; state(){ adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1; }; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state | grep -qx device; test "$(state)" = "0"; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk >/tmp/phase2-downlink-pfd-install.log; cat /tmp/phase2-downlink-pfd-install.log; APK=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | cut -d: -f2 | head -n1); test -n "$APK"; A=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.DownlinkPipeProbe open-abort-offcall"); printf '%s
' "$A"; printf '%s
' "$A" | grep -q 'read_end_acquired=true'; printf '%s
' "$A" | grep -q 'terminated_after_abort=true'; printf '%s
' "$A" | grep -q 'aborted_after_abort=true'; B=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.DownlinkPipeProbe start-offcall"); printf '%s
' "$B"; printf '%s
' "$B" | grep -q 'offcall_start_rejected=true'; printf '%s
' "$B" | grep -q 'terminated_after_start_failure=true'; printf '%s
' "$B" | grep -q 'terminal_failure_present=true'; test "$(state)" = "0"; rm -f /tmp/phase2-downlink-pfd-install.log; echo phase2_downlink_pfd_offcall_ok=true
